Our Story

Meet Moni Das,
The Heart Behind
Every Creation

Creamy Creation was born from Moni Das's deep passion for baking and a desire to bring beautifully handcrafted cakes to every celebration in Guwahati, Assam.

From elegant multi-tier celebration cakes to traditional Assamese sweets, Moni pours her heart into every single order.

🏠100% Homemade - no preservatives, pure quality ingredients
🚚Home delivery available across Guwahati
🎨Fully custom designs for every occasion and theme
💬Easy and quick ordering directly via WhatsApp
